<section class="instruction-page-hero" aria-labelledby="instruction-page-heading">

::: page-shell

<h1 id="instruction-page-heading">Instruction</h1>

<p class="lede">Resources for teaching impact-centered statistical collaboration in consulting, statistics, and data science courses.</p>

<p class="instruction-opening">Instructors are welcome to adapt these materials to their own students, course structure, and teaching context.</p>

:::

</section>

<section class="instruction-section" aria-labelledby="teaching-sequence-heading">

::: page-shell

<div class="instruction-section-heading">
<h2 id="teaching-sequence-heading">Suggested Teaching Sequence</h2>
<p>A short pre-read, a focused class session, and practical follow-through can help students connect statistical work to the impact it is meant to enable.</p>
</div>

<ol class="instruction-sequence">
<li>
<p class="instruction-stage">Before Class</p>
<h3>Set up the conversation.</h3>
<p>Assign the Student Pre-Read and ask students to reflect on a past or upcoming project.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="instruction-stage">During Class</p>
<h3>Make the model concrete.</h3>
<p>Introduce the five components, work through a complete example, and give students time to practice applying the concepts.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="instruction-stage">After Class</p>
<h3>Put it into practice.</h3>
<p>Encourage students to experiment in their collaborations and reflect on how their analytical work translates into impact.</p>
</li>
</ol>

:::

</section>
